name: Dayshift at Freddy's
source:
"Hi, welcome to your new summer job at the new and improved Freddy Fazbender's pizza! 
I just want to ask you...what's wrong with you?!"
"You're in a town with 15 available jobs and yet you still pick the one with the killer robots that gives you less than minimum wage?"

sigh

"Well, okay. Welcome to 1987."

A parody game of the FNAF franchise.
translation:
“嗨，欢迎来到全新改良版弗雷迪·法兹熊披萨店，开始你的暑期工作！
我只想问你……你到底有什么毛病？！”
“镇上明明有15种工作可选，你却偏偏选了这份和杀人机器人打交道、工资还低于最低工资的工作？”

唉。

“好吧。欢迎来到1987年。”

一款《玩具熊的五夜后宫》系列的恶搞游戏。
